title: Possibility and Chance
grammar: Epistemic Modality (lehet hogy, kétlem hogy, elképzelhető) and Future Forecasting
goal: I can say that something is possible, using lehet, hogy.
I can say maybe in different ways with talán, esetleg and hátha.
I can talk about chance and risk with esély and kockázat.
